def pancake_sort(nums):
    # Function to flip the list from 0 to index k
    def flip(arr, k):
        arr[:k+1] = reversed(arr[:k+1])
    
    n = len(nums)
    
    # Start from the end of the list and move towards the beginning
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        # Find the index of the maximum element in the remaining unsorted part
        max_index = nums.index(i)
        
        # If the maximum element is not already at the correct position,
        if max_index != i:
            # Flip the list up to the max element index
            flip(nums, max_index)
            
            # Flip the list up to the start position (index 0)

def flip(lst, i):
    """Flips the first i+1 elements of lst."""
    start = 0
    while start < i:
        lst[start], lst[i] = lst[i], lst[start]
        start += 1

def pancake_sort(nums):
    """Sorts the given list of numbers using the Pancake Sort algorithm."""
    n = len(nums)
    while n > 1:
        # Find the index of the largest element in nums[0..n-1]
        max_index = nums.index(max(nums[:n]))
        
        # Flip the array from 0 to max_index to move the largest number to its correct position
        flip(nums, max_index)
        
        # Flip the entire array to put the largest number at the end
        flip(nums, n - 1)
        
        # Decrease the size of the unsorted part
        n -= 1
